objective: Verify the exact agentkit 1.0.1 maintenance bundle after adding evidence-backed README usage guides to the complete skill portfolio.
baseline: agentkit 1.0.0 stable release at marketplace release 3.3.0
change_class: documentation-only public contract clarification plus deterministic README generation

acceptance.readme_coverage: 47/47 canonical skills have adjacent README.md files
acceptance.readme_contract: every generated block contains use cases, expected results, boundaries, dependencies, resources and verification guidance
acceptance.donor_lock: 10/10 agentkit donors and 12/12 metaskillpack donors match canonical versions and hashes
acceptance.structure: repository, marketplace, registry and package validators pass
acceptance.behavior: existing routing and behavior suites remain unchanged and pass
acceptance.portability: 43 selective packages and one aggregate package reproduce canonical skill contents
acceptance.lifecycle: versions, registry hashes, marketplace release and rollback state agree

execution_policy.side_effects: repository files and generated package staging only
execution_policy.rollback: Git revert to marketplace release 3.5.0 and agentkit 1.0.0
